svg.title: CPU use over the run, from Prometheus
svg.desc: The cores each component used, second by second, and the share of its CPU scheduling periods in which it was throttled, with the bursts shaded.
svg.text: Read from the probes once a second and kept in Prometheus. The shaded columns are the bursts.
Throttling is the share of 100 ms scheduling periods in which a container had used its limit and was stopped until the next.
